snippet.title: Cloud Cats` Land — announcement trailer | Steam
snippet.description:
Cloud Cats are friendly and playful beings who warmly welcome guests to their island. But why does no one know about the island? Where has the lighthouse keeper gone? Are the cats truly innocent in his disappearance?

(look for links in the first comment)

About the Game  
--------------
A classic point-and-click adventure.  
Immerse yourself in the amazing world of Cloud Cats.  
The lost island in the middle of the ocean hides many mysteries to be solved on your journey to reach your goal. Each cat is unique and brings its own magic to your path. Attract the cats to help you solve puzzles, and they will assist you in an unforgettable adventure.
